description_block:
Graded GEM MT 10 by PSA (53204378). Among the more than 1,350 examples of this piece recorded in PSA's census reporting, fewer than 10 percent of copies have achieved this unsurpassable grading tier. Offered is one of the most significant Charizard depictions in the Pokémon collecting hobby, the landmark '03 Skyridge Holo Secret Rare Reverse Foil Flame Pokémon card. This is among the most frustratingly scarce Charizard commemoratives extant, with the significant "Crystal Type" designation and ferocious attack combo of Fireblast and Dragon Tail. Skyridge was the final Pokémon expansion of the e-Card Series of the TCG; coincidentally, it was also the final Pokémon TCG expansion produced by the game's original American publisher, Wizards of the Coast. Due to Wizards losing their license to publish Pokémon TCG collectors, the English-language distribution of Skyridge was significantly smaller than the preceding and succeeding expansions, resulting in a nearly insatiable desire for the set's biggest chase cards, and this commendably preserved piece—featuring perhaps the most popular Pocket Monster in the TCG's history—is one of the premier cards in the expansion.
